resolvedStack: React Native / Expo + Next.js 14 Web Preview + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma
name: RouteMate Courier App
description: RouteMate Courier App is a mobile dispatch companion for last-mile delivery drivers to manage route stops, capture delivery confirmations, and monitor shift earnings with Prisma PostgreSQL.

metadata.name: RouteMate Courier App
metadata.description: Mobile courier app for delivery stops, proof-of-delivery confirmations, and shift earnings.

files.description: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, NextAuth v4, Zod, lucide-react, react-icons.
Expo app configuration for RouteMate Courier App.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, DeliveryStatus, Priority enums and User, DeliveryStop, ShiftSummary, ProofOfDelivery models.
Shared TypeScript interfaces for DeliveryStop, ShiftSummary, ProofOfDelivery.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, and Footer.
Mobile welcome screen for RouteMate Courier App.
Courier shift overview dashboard showing active stops, completed deliveries, and earnings KPIs.
Delivery stops queue with status badges and confirm-delivery action.
Driver shift earnings breakdown and payout history.
Client hook fetching /api/stops on mount via useEffect.
Client hook fetching /api/earnings on mount via useEffect.
GET and POST API route for DeliveryStop records.
GET and POST API route for ShiftSummary records.
